pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/radio/components/TitleCrossfade.tsx:59 overlaps a fading-out old track title with the fading-in new one, the cross-fade of two strangers continuity-across-change names as a failure (an instant switch is the honest form); and src/features/plugins/radio/components/EqualizerBars.tsx:51 runs 16 infinite eq-bounce loops at 0.45-1.1s periods travelling ~32px (globals.css:1520 scaleY 0.2->1 over the h-10 strip), far outside the ambient bound - including the repo's own (motionPresets.ts:16 translate <= 3px, period 3-6s)

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/radio/components/TitleCrossfade.tsx:59 the outgoing title stays mounted under the incoming one for 300ms - two unmatched strings overlapping, not continuity

src/features/plugins/radio/components/EqualizerBars.tsx:51 16 concurrent ambient loops, sub-second periods, ~32px travel on a resting card; the repo's own ambient budget at src/features/shared/components/display/motionPresets.ts:16 is <= 3px over 3-6s

src/features/plugins/radio/components/TitleCrossfade.tsx:3 inlines an off-ladder 300ms (ladder is 50/150/250/400ms at src/styles/globals.css:465-468) and EqualizerBars.tsx:51 builds its timing at the call site from random durations; neither is a named preset nor a declared private exception

src/features/plugins/radio/components/EqualizerBars.tsx:50 has no designed reduced form; its fallback is improvised by the global kill at src/styles/globals.css:4871 (0.01ms, 1 iteration), which happens to leave static full-height bars - benign here, but undesigned

src/styles/globals.css:4931 pauses every CSS loop when the document is hidden, one merged decider at the root; EqualizerBars.tsx:50 reads only the playback (user) decider and stays ignorant of the rest

src/features/plugins/radio/components/RadioFooter.tsx:626 the loop is bound to playback, which carries a visible labelled play/pause button whose state is shown, the honest visible toggle the technique allows
src/styles/globals.css:1520 eq-bounce animates transform only; TitleCrossfade.tsx:50 animates opacity only; the rAF in RadioFooter drives audio volume, not layout
src/features/plugins/radio/components/EqualizerBars.tsx:51 CSS keyframes only, outside the framer MotionConfig global switch at src/App.tsx:386 - every gesture's owner is local and nameable

src/features/plugins/radio/components/TitleCrossfade.tsx:50 the incoming title's fade-in has no fill, so under any reduction the resolved title renders at full opacity; the content-bearing gesture never renders blank

pairs.registryProposal: taste-budgets' class hierarchy has no slot for a media 'now playing' indicator: an equalizer loop implies activity that IS real (playback), so it passes the honesty rule, yet the ambient travel bound condemns its amplitude, which is its whole semantics. Either name it (a status-carrying loop, budgeted by instance count and bound to a visible stop) or state explicitly that such indicators are ambient and should be a single, small, slow mark.
